name: Fitnessalterrechner
description: This tool calculates your fitness age based on your physical activity levels and health metrics. It's perfect for individuals looking to understand their fitness level relative to their chronological age.
metaDescription: Herzfrequenz, BMI und körperliche Aktivität nutzen, um das biologische Alter zu schätzen und den tatsächlichen Gesundheitszustand zu verstehen.
